title: Customer Groups
description: Segment customers for pricing and promotions.

help.title: About Customer Groups
help.overview: Groups segment customers, for example retail and wholesale. A customer can belong to more than one group. Pricing rules read those memberships. The name is required.

sections.title: How a rule sees the customer
sections.body: Membership is a separate record for each customer in a group. The member count on the group is kept in step with those records. A guest cart has no groups.
items: A pricing rule with no groups applies to every cart. A rule that lists groups applies only when the signed-in customer is in one of them.
Set default marks one group as the company default and clears the previous default. It does not add customers by itself.
Deleting a group is a soft delete and it can be restored.
